claimsToVerify.phrase: Tabs: Submissions · Members & leads · Campaigns; detail-pane chip “Added to ‘Leads’ dataset”
claimsToVerify.concern: The Inbox mockup advertises a 'Members & leads' tab and a 'Campaigns' tab. A Contacts CRM is on the do-not-claim list, and 'Campaigns' implies an email-marketing product that no section of copy on this page describes. Either strip those two tabs from the mockup before it is rebuilt, or confirm both features exist. The 'Leads dataset' chip is fine — a dataset named Leads is just a dataset.

claimsToVerify.phrase: Every submission, in one Inbox. / Every submission lands in a single Inbox you can read, mark read or unread, and clear out.
claimsToVerify.concern: Borderline against the 'shared team inbox' prohibition. As written it claims a single submissions Inbox with read/unread state, not a shared team mailbox with assignment or replies — that reads clean to me, but the mockup's 'Members & leads'/'Campaigns' tabs push it toward the forbidden reading. Verify the Inbox has no team-mailbox affordances before shipping.

claimsToVerify.phrase: Trigger an email, a webhook, or an admin alert on every submission with an automation. / fire an email or webhook with an automation
claimsToVerify.concern: Automation claim is submission-triggered only, so it does not claim scheduled/cron triggers or a visual workflow canvas — but confirm outbound email and webhook actions both ship, since the Explore card on all three pages also sells 'Workflows — Automate the busywork with triggers & actions.'
